vat.note: Standard Dutch VAT rate, applies to electricity supply, energy tax and grid fees.

2026.note: Published as 0.11085 EUR/kWh incl. VAT; 0.11085 / 1.21 = 0.09161. Check against the Belastingdienst table.

2027.note: Belastingplan 2027 (corrected key table), about 0.1065 EUR/kWh incl. VAT. Not final until the law is passed.
Overstappen.nl reports 628.69 EUR incl. VAT, Gaslicht reports 629.69. Sources disagree; verify.

grid_fee.note: Representative value, roughly 460 EUR/year incl. VAT. Look up your own grid operator.

supply_price.note: Supply price excluding energy tax and VAT. All-in this gives about 0.27 EUR/kWh.

feed_in_compensation.note: Terugleververgoeding. Under netting it is paid only on the annual surplus; from 2027 on every kWh fed in. No VAT (most households fall under the small-business scheme). Assumed unchanged in 2027.

feed_in_cost.note: Terugleverkosten per kWh fed in (gross, before netting), VAT added. Some suppliers use tiered monthly fees instead; this is a per-kWh approximation.

standing_charge.note: Vaste leveringskosten, about 6 EUR/month excl. VAT.

markup.note: Supplier markup (inkoopvergoeding) on the hourly day-ahead price for consumption.

feed_in_fee.note: Amount deducted from the day-ahead price for each kWh fed in. Some suppliers deduct nothing.

feed_in_vat_while_netting.note: Whether, under netting (2026), the hourly feed-in price is credited including VAT. Approximation applied to all feed-in; verify with supplier terms.

standing_charge.note: Vaste leveringskosten, about 5 EUR/month excl. VAT.
